title: Tortilla Chip-Crusted Tofu Salad with Tomatoes, Cheese & Ranch

steps.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Place tortilla chips in a large bowl and crush with the back of a spoon to create coarse crumbs. Add spices and stir to combine the coating.
Cut tofu crosswise into planks. Wipe baking sheet dry with paper towels and return tofu to the pan.

Spread half of the mayo over top side of the tofu, sprinkle with half of the coating, and drizzle with half of the oil. Carefully flip tofu and repeat with remaining mayo, coating, and oil. (Reserve bowl for the salad.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until tofu is golden brown, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and medium dice tomatoes. Place in the reserved bowl.
Wash, dry, and chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the tomato, toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
When the tofu is done, slice crosswise into strips.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls, then top with cheese and tofu. Drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!
